# Project Instructions

- At the start of every task, read `PROJECT_STATE.md` first.
- Do only the step the user gives. Never touch unrelated code.
- At the end of each task, run the build and lint checks, fix any errors, update `PROJECT_STATE.md`, make a Git commit, and explain in plain English how to test the change. If a check cannot run because the project is not set up for it yet, say so clearly.
- Keep code clean, typed, and in small files. Avoid duplicate code. Aim for production quality, accessibility, mobile-first layouts, and fast performance.
- Never put API keys in code. Use `.env.local` for local secrets and keep it out of Git.
- Use Google Gemini (`@google/genai`) for AI features. Do not use Claude or OpenAI.
- For Next.js work, read the matching installed guide in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/`; follow the version-specific guidance for this project.
